overall.summary: Physician's Solution appears to be a broad ambulatory EHR/PM/RCM platform, but EHI export documentation could not be accessed from the ONC-registered URL; export mechanism, format, and covered domains are therefore not determinable from this evidence set.

notableFacts: CHPL-linked target is Physician's Solution (CHPL ID 11214, version 11, certification Jan 17, 2023).
The registered EHI export guidance endpoint at https://mraemr.com:47102/api/DataExportGuidance.asp was unreachable (connection refused) with reproducible attempts.
Alternate checks against mraemr.com:47102 and related mandatory disclosure endpoint were similarly unreachable, indicating a likely dead or firewalled documentation path.
The standard mraemr.com HTTPS site is reachable but shows expired certificate issues and login redirects, and does not expose EHI export documentation.

Product scope evidence shows substantial EHR, practice management, and revenue-cycle functionality (demographics, encounters, meds/allergies, labs, imaging workflows, billing/claims, scheduling, portal), but no public export specs were found to verify migration completeness.
